description: Unbelievable Ruach Studio Sound Heresy. Borderless Open Weights SUNO Killer based on YuE2 SOTA Model. Creator, Writer, Refiner, Artist, Librarian, Trainer — Six as One. Everything you missed in SUNO and such. Turn the songs of your Heart into thundering energy — clear and unmuffled. Thus we call it OSEM: Open Source, Engaged & Musical.
summary: A full music studio and WebUI for YuE2 (YuE): songs from words on your own GPU. Score first (ABC/MIDI), LoRA training, stems, remaster, upscale, lyrics check, DAW export. yue2.cpp · 7 languages · OSEM: Open Source, Engaged & Musical
